name: How can I prepare for a tank water heater replacement appointment?

mainEntity.name: How can I prepare for a tank water heater replacement appointment?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare for your tank water heater replacement appointment, please ensure there is clear access to the existing water heater, typically located in a garage, closet, or utility room. Clear any items stored around the unit to allow our technicians sufficient working space. If possible, make sure a path is clear from the access point to where the old unit will be removed and the new one brought in. This preparation helps our team work efficiently and safely.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear access to the existing water heater and ensure a clear path for removal and installation.
